description.login: Your device will then ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN. There is no password.
description.recovery-sent: If that account exists, a new registration link is on its way to the address on file.

error.authenticator-error: Your device could not provide the passkey. Check that a screen lock or PIN is set up.
error.insecure-context: Passkeys only work over a secure connection. Open the page via HTTPS or localhost.
error.no-ceremony: The sign-in attempt expired. Please start again.
error.no-passkey-or-aborted: Cancelled, or this device holds no matching passkey. Use the device you set it up on.
error.recovery-failed: That didn't work just now. Try again later.
error.rejected: The passkey was not accepted. The attempt may have timed out — please try again.
error.unknown-username: No account with that username — or it has not set up a passkey yet.
error.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
error.wrong-domain: This passkey was registered for a different address and does not apply here.
